import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set a style for better aesthetics
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create the visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Stress Level',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    sizes=(50, 800), # Adjust marker size range for Physical Activity Level
    palette='viridis', # Colormap for Stress Level
    alpha=0.7,
    edgecolor='w', # Add white edge for better visibility of markers
    linewidth=0.5
)

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs. Quality of Sleep: Impact of Stress and Physical Activity', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 scale)', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(fontsize=10)
plt.yticks(fontsize=10)

# Move the legend outside the plot area for clarity
plt.legend(title='Metrics', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0)

# Ensure layout adjusts to prevent legend or labels from being cut off
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
